mapper.select: SELECT COMMENT_NO , BOARD_NO , PARENT_COMMENT_NO , WRITER , CONTENT , TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REG_DT FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY NVL(PARENT_COMMENT_NO, COMMENT_NO) , CASE WHEN PARENT_COMMENT_NO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , REG_DT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT (COMMENT_NO, BOARD_NO, PARENT_COMMENT_NO, WRITER, CONTENT, REG_DT) VALUES ((SELECT NVL(MAX(COMMENT_NO), 0) + 1 FROM TB_COMMENT), #{boardNo}, #{parentCommentNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{writer}, #{content}, SYSDATE)
